name: inbox-command-center
description: Inbox Command Center — AI communications manager that triages multi-account email (Gmail and Outlook via the local Himalaya CLI over IMAP/SMTP), Slack, iMessage, and messaging platforms across all your inboxes at once. Auto-categorizes messages, drafts replies in your authentic voice (Fireflies meeting transcripts as primary signal, refined by sent email, Slack, iMessage, draft edits, and A/B calibration), manages calendar conflicts, and tracks todos and followups in a hand-editable workspace folder at ~/Inbox Command Center/. Smart rules engine with type (delete/prioritize/folder/organize) × stakes (low/high) × scope (per-inbox/global). VIP cross-inbox scan at session start with pre-written drafts. Daily briefings and VIP digests, monthly inbox reports with cross-inbox + per-inbox sections, weekly Fireflies pulls feeding voice profile and per-recipient contacts.md notes, and reminders via dedicated Slack channel, Slack DM, or iMessage. Integrates with Brand Knowledge Center for brand-voice drafting.
